gate: Requires explicit --all-closed and exact author seal SHA; records QUALIFIED only for exactly four named current PASS and both exit0. Otherwise records NOT_QUALIFIED, preserves errors, missing/unnamed records, and does not demand complete positive artifacts.
test_body_limit: A JUnit fixture ERROR or absent B record does not prove B body executed; do not count windows unless retained evidence establishes execution.
limits: No audit execution invoked; no run8 artifacts or DB/product/network read.
